cv_summary: Bilingual STEM Educator & Engineer with 4 years teaching IGCSE/A-Level Physics and Mathematics internationally. B.Sc. Engineering Science (University of Tripoli, 2021). Currently Physics Teacher at Vision International School (2023–present), delivering IGCSE Physics (since 2023) and A-Level Physics (since 2025). Previous experience at Kids Academy International School, Ladybird International School, and Knowledge Training Center. Technical background in mechanical/electrical diagnostics and industrial systems from Alsahl Group. Native Arabic speaker, fluent English. Based in Libya, seeking international school positions.
